markdownRemark.html:
Let's think about anti social app. The one that focused on isolation, anonymity, low-fiction avoidance. It would encourage self-exression more than connection.

So mainly no chat, no replies, no mentions, no followers. You can post but no likes. Nothing crazy, just friction-maximizing for interaction and friction-minimizing for solitude, which makes it a privacy-first pseudonymous micro-journaling space.

What sociological and philosophical movements considered anti-social?

  • Stirnerism or ==Stirnerite== Egoism
  • Ayn Rand–style Objectivism

Social data archive viewer

For UI I will use GTK4 bindings for Rust (which I already have installed since I compiled Fractal on Windows.
